profile.headline: Software Engineer @ AVT Simulation
profile.summary: A passionate and driven engineer seeking to apply their knowledge in computer architectures and security in the development of secure novel computer systems, with a long-term goal of working towards the design and development of low cost, low power CPUs that deliver high performance to help bridge the technology gap in K-12 school systems. Seeking to work in a environment that places emphasis on mutual understanding conducive towards the innovation of new tools and frameworks for the analysis of computing systems.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Flashed, assembled, and maintained air quality sensors that were deployed across the Greater Orlando metropolitan area. Pursued solutions in the monitoring of toxic gas in an enclosed environment.

company.name: UCF Department of Civil, Environmental, and Construction Engineering

positions.title: R&D Firmware Engineer Intern
positions.description: Develop firmware for the X-series line of signal analyzers as a member of the High Frequency Measurements team.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: AP Computer Science Principles Volunteering @ Colonial High School
volunteerExperiences.description: What began as a personal project is soon developing into a volunteer framework to be proposed to Colonial High School. The involvement of college students in the teaching of programming concepts in the Python language to prepare high school students enrolled in AP Computer Science Principles for their AP exam, as a third of their exam comprises a programming project to be submitted. Leading team of two other fellow classmates on arranging what the students will learn each week in active collaboration with the class instructor, sending weekly updates.

company.name: AP Computer Science Principles Volunteering @ Colonial High School

projects.title: Dynamic Instruction Scheduling Simulator
projects.description: Implemented configurable simulator for an out-of-order superscalar processor based on Tomasulo's algorithm that fetches, decodes, and issues up to N instructions per cycle. Scripted Python code to automate gathering of key performance metrics, such as IPC count, for different configurations.

projects.title: Branch Predictor Simulator
projects.description: Developed a simulator program to simulate different configurable branch predictors well suited for SPECint95 benchmarks. Simulator provided key performance metrics used to compare different predictors and configurations. Scripted Python code was used to automate different simulations.
